title: WP5 AG-UI projection gate (G2)
head: 98c47e4 merge(wp5): AG-UI 1.0 run projection

gate.name: G2 契约就绪
gate.definition: WP4 + WP5：REST 与 AG-UI 的契约测试通过，CLI 消费新协议
gate.interpretation_note: No product CLI existed before this gate; the reference CLI apps/server/src/cli.ts is the first consumer added here. The prototype CLI in infra/pi-durable-validation was deliberately not replaced. If '切换 CLI' is meant to require replacing an existing product CLI, that remains a follow-up.

scope: POST /v1/agent foreground run projection to AG-UI 1.0: RUN_STARTED/RUN_ERROR first, TEXT_MESSAGE_*, TOOL_CALL_START/ARGS/END/RESULT, STEP_STARTED/FINISHED (turn-N), RUN_FINISHED(outcome+usage), strict LIFO entity closing, tolerance rules, transport-vs-SSE boundary, reserved point.ui.* CUSTOM contract, reference CLI.

results.details: 316/316 tests, 0 failed, 0 skipped (server 305 + scripts 11); clean build included
13/13 AG-UI contract tests incl. strict LIFO order, nested tools, multi-step, tolerance, truncation, cancellation
11/11 boundary tests incl. the new explicit cli.ts lane (node: builtins only)

independentVerification.round1: 10/10 via real startServer + real openRuntime/SQLite + own SSE parser: frames, boundaries, failure RUN_ERROR, truncation without FINISHED, cancellation, tolerance/fail-closed, auth, run isolation, point.ui, reference CLI
independentVerification.round2: 15/15 on the LIFO fix: exact cancellation frame suffix TEXT_MESSAGE_END -> STEP_FINISHED -> RUN_FINISHED(cancelled); tool LIFO via projection and scripted HTTP port; validator hardening; cli.ts lane; transport-vs-SSE boundary

independentAudit.first: docs/team/reviews/wp5-agui-projection.md - 1 blocker: closeEntities grouped by type instead of strict LIFO
independentAudit.reaudit: docs/team/reviews/wp5-agui-projection-reaudit.md - B1 fixed; 1 remaining blocker: point.ui accepted document./window. dot references

closedBlockers: AG-UI entity closing was grouped by type (tool, step, message) instead of strict last-opened-first-closed; replaced with a single open-entity stack
point.ui validator accepted DOM dot references (document.cookie, window.location); added normalized DOM_REFERENCE rejection
point.ui validator accepted attribute injection, code-shaped strings, obfuscated schemes and proto-polluting keys; strict allowlist added
cli.ts was an unregistered root file skipped by the boundary checker; now an explicit lane limited to node: builtins
usage_derivation: RUN_FINISHED.usage is a diff of the session UsageState ledger aggregated per model/tool bucket: derived, not a provider bill (no cost, no per-call split, retry/compaction attribution may differ). Documented in README and design.
unverified: real provider token streaming, network drops/reconnects and rate limiting (only pi-ai faux provider used)
real tool execution end-to-end into TOOL_CALL_* frames (foreground chat run does not register a tool extension; tool ordering covered via projection and scripted port)
multi-client / follow-up run isolation beyond two concurrent runs on one chat
SSE reverse-proxy buffering, backpressure, half-open/EPIPE handling (no explicit response error listener)
Last-Event-ID, state/messages snapshots, ACTIVITY, run stream (WP6) and interrupt/resume (WP7)
duplicate end events may emit duplicate END frames (SDK does not normally repeat)
point.ui bracket-form DOM access (document["cookie"]) not covered; no emission path exists yet
high-frequency concurrency, long runs, idle/settle timeouts
notes: AG-UI types stay confined to apps/server/src/api/agui/**, runtime exposes provider-neutral events, application/domain stay SDK- and AG-UI-free. No new dependencies, no second execution engine, no second source of facts.
